title: 曹冲称象

license.content: 儿童故事：旁白为自写口语复述（出自《三国志·魏书》，公有领域）；底图、配乐为 AI 原创生成，音效代码合成

music.title: Cao Chong Weighs the Elephant
music.author: Galanty
music.attribution: Cao Chong Weighs the Elephant — Galanty, original children's score generated with Lyria 3 Pro and edited with code-synthesized sound effects (CC0 1.0)
music.modifications: Two cues generated with Google Lyria 3 Pro (lyria-3-pro-preview) from original timeline prompts (tools/production/cao-chong-20261013/music/cue1, cue2); joined by tools/production/cao-chong-20261013/music_build.py: cue 1 hard-stops on the 'reached the line' beat, cue 2 starts at the weighing scene, a 12 dB dip for the children's thinking pause, 5 dB pre-duck under narration, 137 NumPy-synthesized sound effects (pops, splashes, stone thuds, a bell 'ding', xylophone counting, a fanfare; no third-party samples), then encoded to 40 kbps MP3, 48 kHz stereo (stays under the 512 KiB repository file limit). Timed to sample S112; other films will not hit its accents.

note: 给 4～9 岁小朋友的绘本风故事动画。旁白为预先生成的 Gemini 云端配音（随包旁白种子，播放不联网），曹冲那句“我有办法！”是同一音色的童声风格；改旁白文字后新句需要本机配音整片重配。底图与贴纸（AI 生成）以 data URI 内联在幕代码里。水面、刻线、石头落船与水位、秤盘指针、等式都是代码画的，卡点词在各幕参数里。配乐 Cao Chong Weighs the Elephant（CC0，随包曲库 library:original-cao-chong）按本片逐字时间轴剪接，“到线了”处骤停并带合成音效：改节奏或换曲后音效不再对齐。正文约 93.8 秒，导出时接约 4.9 秒品牌片尾
